patterns.note: Project showcases feature an asymmetrical, overlapping collage-like arrangement of images and text blocks, creating a dynamic visual composition within each section.
A sophisticated pairing of an elegant, large-scale serif font for primary headings and section titles, contrasted with a clean, understated sans-serif for body text and navigation.
A minimalist, warm off-white background serves as a canvas for dark text, allowing vibrant, diverse accent colors to emerge exclusively from the rich, artistic project imagery.
The main navigation bar becomes sticky at the top of the viewport after initial scroll, and footer text elements subtly rearrange their layout as they come into view.
Each project section follows a consistent structure: a large, visually rich image collage, a concise descriptive text block, and a prominent 'Explore [Project Name]' call-to-action link.

technique_notes: The site utilizes a sticky header navigation that fixes to the top of the viewport on scroll. Content sections scroll vertically in a standard manner. Subtle scroll-triggered animations are used for specific text elements, such as the footer branding, which rearranges its layout as it enters the viewport. Project imagery is presented in a layered, overlapping fashion, suggesting depth and dynamic composition.
Image compositions within project sections are built using a combination of varied aspect ratios and overlapping placements, creating a curated, almost editorial collage effect.

design_tokens.type_scale: Elegant, large serif headings (~3-4x body) with generous line height, paired with clean, legible sans-serif body text and small, uppercase navigation/footer links.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle; image containers feature gently rounded corners, while other elements maintain sharp edges.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy; very generous vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, creating a sense of calm and focus. Text blocks are balanced.

standout: The site's distinctive use of asymmetrical, overlapping image collages within each project section, combined with refined serif typography and a minimalist color palette, creates an artistic and editorial feel that elevates it beyond a typical portfolio site. The subtle motion of footer text elements also adds a unique touch.
